Backend APIs: POST /api/projects/{id}/project-rooms (add room), DELETE /api/projects/{id}/project-rooms/{room_id} (delete), POST /api/projects/{id}/project-rooms/bulk (bulk add), POST /api/projects/{id}/analyze-floor-plan (AI floor plan analysis), POST /api/projects/{id}/calculate-renovation (run calculator), GET /api/projects/{id}/renovation-calculation (get results), PUT .../items/{id}?included=true/false (toggle), PUT .../switch-option (floor finish), PUT .../switch-scenario (wall scenario), POST /api/projects/{id}/generate-quote-from-calculation (generate quote), POST /api/work-items/auto-save (save manual item). All APIs are LIVE, GPT-4o Vision for floor plan analysis via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.

POST /api/projects/{id}/project-rooms.details: Adds single room with automatic area calculations

POST /api/projects/{id}/analyze-floor-pl.details: Endpoint exists and returns success. Full AI analysis requires image upload (GPT-4o Vision live)

POST /api/projects/{id}/calculate-renova.details: Calculates renovation using live DB prices, returns calculation_id, total_min, total_recommended, rooms_calculated

GET /api/projects/{id}/renovation-calcul.details: Returns full calculation with room_calculations containing floor_items, wall_items, ceiling_items, other_items

PUT /api/projects/{id}/renovation-calcul.details: Switch floor finish options (tegels, parket, laminaat, vinyl)

POST /api/projects/{id}/generate-quote-f.details: Creates quote with line items from all included calculation items. Returns quote_id, line_items_count, totals

POST /api/work-items/auto-save.details: Auto-saves manual work items for future reuse. Case-insensitive duplicate detection
